items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Great piano player like Mitchell Frasier, Alec Frasier. Alec Frasier? Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, they do say that, Gentilly.

Yeah, but all that's sick with Seabrook. That's where the biggest portion of my family comes from, on my grandfather's side, the Frasiers. Great piano player like Mitchell Frasier, Alec Frasier. Alec Frasier? Yeah.
